Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Meera - 10 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Shalini - 40 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Rajesh - 37 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Meera, Shalini and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Kunal combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Meera: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Meera applies kajal to her eyes.]

Meera: "Kunal, look at this."

[Kunal talks to his father on the phone.]

Meera: "Yes, all right."

[Kunal's phone rings and he answers it.]

Kunal: "That's easy."

[Kunal lies down on the sofa.]

Shalini (softly): "Exactly right."

[Kunal flops down on the sofa.]

Meera (gently): "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The garden - Day

Meera: "What a nice place."

[Kunal waters the plants.]

Meera: "Really?"

[Kunal chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Meera: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "Shalini, look over here."

[Kunal trips over a stone.]

Kunal (happily): "Dad, are you okay?"

[Kunal hurts his knee.]

Shalini: "I'm ready!"

[Kunal helps Mother get up.]

Kunal: "That's easy."

[Kunal sneezes loudly.]

Shalini (surprised): "How beautiful!"

[Kunal coughs.]

Kunal: "That was such a fun day!"
